metaTitle: Custom Recyclable Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recyclable badge ID holders in bulk. Eco-friendly, durable, and perfect for your brand. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom recyclable badge ID holders let you maintain a professional appearance while supporting your company's sustainability goals. Made from materials that can be recycled after use, these holders are ideal for trade shows, corporate offices, and events where single-use plastic is discouraged. Choose from clear or frosted finishes, and add your logo with screen printing or debossing. They offer the same durability as traditional holders, with the added benefit of being easier on the planet.
heroAltText: Custom recyclable badge ID holders with clear plastic and logo imprint, displayed on a lanyard.
